key.name: enable-codex
key.description: Query local Codex usage only after opting in. Disabling monitoring does not log out.

key.name: enable-claude
key.description: Watch locally exported Claude snapshots only after opting in. Disabling monitoring does not log out.

key.name: codex-path
key.description: Leave blank to find codex in the GNOME Shell PATH, or specify an absolute executable path. Arguments are not accepted.

key.name: claude-cli-mode
key.summary: Use the experimental read-only Claude CLI usage interface
key.description: Explicit opt-in for Team and other supported accounts. Sends initialize/get_usage control requests only, never a model prompt. Replaces passive statusline monitoring without merging sources.

key.name: claude-path
key.summary: Claude executable for experimental usage queries
key.description: Leave empty for PATH or the native ~/.local/bin/claude location. Absolute paths only, no arguments.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: Codex and opt-in Claude CLI reads share this interval. Passive Claude statusline monitoring does not poll.
